answer: The comet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the river is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
